units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 39:29">Targ. O. Ex. XXXIX, 29</cite> (ed. Berl.; oth. ed. <cite ref="E00431"><he>הֶמְ׳</he></cite>); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Eruvin 94a">Erub. 94ᵃ</cite> <he>שקילו הִמְיָינֵיה וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="E00433"><he>הימני׳</he></cite>, corr. acc.) take his belt and tie &c.
<cite ref="Megillah 27b:5">Meg. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>משבנתיה להִמְיָינָאִי</he> I pawned my belt.
<cite ref="Zevachim 19a:2">Zeb. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>הוה מִדְּלֵי לי המיינאי וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="E00424"><he>הִימְיָנָאִי</he></cite>) my belt had slipped upward and he himself pulled it down.—
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 28:4">Targ. O. Ex. XXVIII, 4</cite> (ed. Berl.; oth. ed. <he>הֶ׳</he>).—Sabb. l. c., v. <cite ref="S01496"><he>קַמְרָא</he></cite>.
